notes: Replaces native smooth scrolling with a distance-aware eased animation for softer acceleration, longer glides, and gentler settling while preserving instant reduced-motion behavior and immediate user cancellation. Adds a compact session-local Planner Activity center with unread counts and non-blocking toasts for saves, scans, updates, exports, warnings, and failures. Browser alert messages are replaced with persistent local activity feedback; destructive confirmations remain explicit. Planner data and scan state are unchanged.
